Backups no longer fail because of one file Flytower can't read. A scheduled backup could stop with "Cannot open: Permission denied" when spark was profiling, because Java makes spark's scratch files private to the server. Those scratch files, and any file ending in `.tmp`, are now left out of backups, and any other file that can't be read is skipped with a note on the backup's job instead of failing the whole backup.

Testing notes are in the last section of [testing-1.1.0.md](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/v1.1.0-beta.5/docs/testing-1.1.0.md).
